text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with 14 field reps for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

The wins were real. Reps saved about 5 hours a week on CRM updates, and follow-up emails went out same-day instead of three days later.

But the surprises mattered more:

1. Customers noticed. Asking consent up front built trust, and two prospects said it showed professionalism.

2. Summaries missed nuance. Tone, hesitation, and unspoken objections still needed a human ear.

3. Managers gained visibility into deal risk, but only after we agreed the tool coaches, not polices.

4. Adoption followed the best-liked rep, not the mandate.

Our takeaway: AI handles the record. Reps handle the relationship.

What did your team learn from piloting AI tools?
